answer: The vine test I would run is Slashable bond with public fraud proofs: anyone can submit fraud proof and slash the bond, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. Each account presents its proof once, the network verifies it in seconds, and a farm that wants ten accounts must pass ten independent checks — the saffron is that the work cannot be shared or replayed. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here. The shale grows with every clone, but the reward per clone stays fixed, so the farm goes broke before it goes big.
